No split is printed, so 'other' plus decision_needed is defensible, but the reviewer should know.

p4 does break it down. General sales tax 56,297, interest 23,893, franchise 2,077 and charges 18,946 make 101,213; the remaining ~127,432 (56%) is misc income. 'Other' as the dominant part is defensible, but the review note should name the mix.
